summary: Focused static assessment of local feedback, ratings, notifications, assignments, and weekly-task rules referenced in the handover. Unauthorized cross-user writes are permitted. This score applies only to this inspected subset, not a completed whole-project audit; deployed rules and runtime exploitability were not tested.

findings.check: Field-Level vs. Identity-Level Security; Authority Source
findings.issue: ratings, feedback, and notifications allow create/update/delete for any authenticated identity, irrespective of target learner, coach class membership, or authorship.
findings.recommendation: Require the intended authorized coach/class relationship, bind author identity to auth.uid, restrict edits/deletes to authorized actors, and separately allow only appropriate learner notification read-state updates. Add emulator tests denying student and unrelated-coach writes.

findings.issue: Assignments and weekly tasks authorize update using only resource.data.classId; the new classId is not protected, permitting reassignment into a class the caller does not teach.
findings.recommendation: Protect classId and ownership as immutable unless reassignment is explicitly supported; otherwise require authorized membership for both old and new classes and validate permitted changed fields.

findings.issue: The inspected feedback/rating/notification write rules do not enforce allowed fields, value types, text limits, or rating ranges. Authorship can be forged and oversized or malformed records accepted within platform limits.
findings.recommendation: Validate allowed/required keys, field types and limits, rating range, and author identity on create and update; enforce immutable provenance.
